message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing) across all sides. A commonly cited breakdown is:

| Side | Casualties (approx.) |
|------|----------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian (Allied forces) | ~22,000 |

These figures include those killed, wounded, and taken prisoner or missing. Exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places total casualties in the mid‑20s of thousands.
